title: specs: fix episode-stream schema gaps from edge-case pass
description:
Apply the schema-shaped findings from the ingestion idempotence edge-case pass to specs/ingestion-contract.md:

- typed absent marker replacing the `unknown` sentinel (MATH-003; ic_verbatim + ic_date_fidelity)
- empty/whitespace-only verbatim text counts as missing (MATH-001; ic_malformed)
- stable-id canonical form (MATH-004; new ic_id_canon)
- per-episode outcome record schema (ARCH-001; new ic_outcome-schema)
- partial-batch convergence + concurrency (BIZ-001/FAIL-001; new ic_batch_resume + ic_unique_id)

Every new constraint needs a deriving property; spk lint must pass. Also update the locator-convention reference in openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/design.md. Non-schema findings (mutated-resubmission decision, deletion re-ingest, parked-episode retry) stay as separate tickets.

title: cli: argument errors bypass the suite envelope contract
description:
Rule-of-5 review EDGE-001 (2026-09-29, verified empirically): `bajan nosuchcmd` emits clap's plain-text usage error (exit 2) — no JSON envelope. Violates the 'envelope is the single output format' invariant at the most common user mistake; a consumer piping to jq '.ok' gets nothing parseable.

Fix: Cli::try_parse_from in main; on Err emit an error envelope (code argument_error, remediation = usage hint) to stdout + exit non-zero when --json. Check genesis::cli (Output::to_envelope) for an existing helper before hand-rolling.

Regression: test that a bad subcommand still emits envelope_version 0.1 JSON with ok:false.

title: main: exit non-zero on ok:false envelope
description:
Rule-of-5 review CORR-001 (2026-09-29, verified empirically): main() always exits 0, even when the suite envelope reports ok:false — `bajan ingest` emits an error envelope and exits 0. Machine consumers gating on exit status see success for every stub.

Fix: have cli::run surface ok (or return the typed envelope) and std::process::exit(1) on ok:false. Fold into the first implementation ticket (bajan-0hs.3) or land as a tiny standalone fix before it.

Regression: shell harness asserting non-zero exit on a stub error path.

title: deps: pin deterministic NLP/IR crates for post-pass + evidence-span tooling
description:
Pin the deterministic NLP/IR crates for bajan's post-persist passes and
converter tooling. Source: investigation of 2026-09-29 (Rule-of-5 reviewed,
verdict READY-WITH-NOTES; corrections below are incorporated).

Grounding: knowledge-graphs-report.md "deterministic-first pipeline"
(avoid LLMs wherever traditional IR/NLP works; Chalef simhash/entropy
dedup; Blumenfeld idempotent structural loading) + specs/ingestion-contract.md
(ic_no_format_parsing, ic_id_canon) + specs/extraction-claims.md
(ex_no_llm_post, ex_deterministic_structure, ex_reflection) +
openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance (ex_evidence_containment, D3).

## Crates — inside bajan (post-persist, format-free; ic_no_format_parsing applies)

| Task (spec anchor) | Default pick | Fallback |
|---|---|---|
| NFC id canonicalization (ic_id_canon) | `unicode-normalization` | none needed — Unicode std algo |
| Sentence boundary detection — alignment aid for extractor + reflection flag pass, NOT the gate (ex_reflection; design.md D3 unknown-span path) | `unicode-segmentation` (UAX #29, script-neutral) | `pragmatic-segmenter` (verify maintenance + English bias) or UAX #29 + small custom abbreviation table |
| Chunk assembly for the single extraction call (ex_single_call) | `text-splitter` (tiktoken mode optional) | hand-rolled split on UAX #29 sentence bounds |
| Token budget counting | `tiktoken-rs` | estimate via chars/4 for dev builds |
| Simhash/entropy dedup (ex_no_llm_post) | `simhash` crate (verify quality among same-named crates) | hand-rolled 64-bit char-n-gram simhash (~50 lines); entropy inline |
| Whitespace-collapsed containment check (ex_evidence_containment, lands via bajan-0hs.3) | `aho-corasick` or `memchr` | std substring search |

## Crates — upstream converters only (conform to episode-stream schema; NEVER bajan deps)

- Markdown: `comrak` or `pulldown-cmark` (headings/links → locators + structure markers)
- HTML: `html5ever`/`scraper`
- EPUB: `epub` crate
- PDF: `pdf-extract` or poppler `pdftotext` — weakest deterministic link; bounded by verbatim-persistence + locator-absent-marker contract

## Design note (CORR-001, HIGH): chunking vs ex_single_call

specs/extraction-claims.md:40 mandates exactly one successful LLM
extraction call per (episode id, extractor version). Chunking is input
ASSEMBLY for one call: chunks are concatenated / passed as one multi-part
prompt; output cached under the single (episode, version) key. Never one
call per chunk. Record in the bajan-0hs.3 implementation notes.

## Corrections from the review (incorporated above)

- CORR-002/EDGE-003: evidence spans are verbatim substrings, not
  necessarily sentence-aligned; containment gate is pure string ops; SBD
  is alignment aid only.
- EDGE-001 (HIGH): language coverage — UAX #29 is the language-neutral
  default; any abbreviation-table approach must declare locale bias.
- EDGE-002: short-episode dedup — simhash/entropy unreliable on very
  short texts; length-guard: below threshold use exact normalized-match.

## Acceptance criteria

- Every crate in the "inside bajan" table verified live: `cargo add --dry-run`,
  docs.rs existence, last-release recency, maintainer activity — pin exact
  versions in Cargo.toml (network was unavailable at investigation time).
- Chosen simhash crate passes a smoke test: near-duplicate pair (small edit
  distance) vs unrelated pair, simhash distance ordering as expected.
- Property-test generators extended per review: p_no_llm_post generators
  include short episodes, non-English (e.g. Spanish/German) episodes;
  evidence-span tests include whole-episode spans (p_typed_gate /
  ex_evidence_containment when bajan-0hs.3 lands).
- `cargo build && cargo test && cargo clippy -- -D warnings` stay green.
- Regression: full test suite green at close.

## Anti-goals

- No format parsers (markdown/PDF/EPUB/HTML) as bajan dependencies.
- No fuzzy matching in the containment GATE (rapidfuzz allowed only in the
  advisory reflection flag pass, if ever).
- No embedding-based entity matching (explicitly deferred).
- No ML/model runtime dependencies.
design: Rule-of-5 review verdict: READY-WITH-NOTES (converged stage 4). Top corrections incorporated: chunking is single-call input assembly (ex_single_call), SBD is alignment aid not gate, language-coverage + short-episode dedup caveats.
acceptance_criteria: Live-verify + pin every crate in the inside-bajan table (cargo add --dry-run, docs.rs recency); simhash smoke test passes; p_no_llm_post generators extended with short + non-English episodes; whole-episode-span generator noted for bajan-0hs.3; build/test/clippy -D warnings green
notes: Related: informs bajan-2xv (scaffold picks core crates) and bajan-0hs.3 (containment tooling). No formal deps: crate verification can precede scaffold.

title: specs: ingestion resubmission policy decisions
description:
From the ingestion idempotence edge-case pass — decisions the schema pass deliberately left open. Amend ingestion.contract to resolve:

- [BIZ-002] mutated re-submission (same id, altered text/metadata): deterministically-update vs reject-with-reason. The lineage-cascade argument ([ARCH-003]: an update orphans claims whose lineage text no longer matches, violating gm_hedge_anchor) favors reject; decide and encode as a constraint + property.
- [EDGE-001/FORM-003] rejected-exit path: add the rejected -> persisted transition for corrected-record re-submission (the ic_outcome-schema contract implies a recovery path the state machine lacks).
- [BIZ-004] intra-batch duplicate ids: first-wins + per-record rejection vs whole-batch rejection — specify.
- [MATH-002] empty stream (zero episodes): valid no-op or rejected — specify.

Constraint: every new constraint needs a deriving property; spk lint + ah check pass. Should land before the ingest module implementation inside bajan-2xv's scope (scaffold stubs are unaffected).
notes: Scope addendum from issue-review: also decide encode reorder-insensitivity [BIZ-006] — re-ingesting the same stream in a different episode order yields an identical graph (extend p_idempotent generator with a shuffled variant). MUST GATE (quantified): 4+1 decisions encoded as constraints, each with a deriving property; spk lint specs reports 0 issues. METER: spk lint specs/ && ah check — both exit 0. ANTI-GOALS: no implementation code, no touching src/, no new spec files, no resolving BIZ-003/BIZ-005 (own tickets), no schema-format changes beyond the decided constraints. REGRESSION: existing 3-spec corpus stays lint-clean; ic_outcome-schema/ic_batch_resume/ic_unique_id/ic_id_canon unchanged in meaning.

title: Implement extraction run records + machine-readable reasons
description: Applies openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/tasks.md 5.1-5.2, TDD. Red: every extraction call writes a run row (episode id, extractor version, model id if any, timestamps, finish status); parked episodes (after repeated call failure) and gate rejections carry machine-readable reasons; claim nodes carry no reason field (gm_schema_v2 field list stays closed). Green: run-record store and reason plumbing beside the existing (episode id, extractor version) cache; ex_single_call economics unchanged.
notes: Layout from bajan-2xv is in place; the run-record store is created by this ticket. Meter: cargo test — run-row + reason plumbing property red, then green. ANTI-GOAL: reasons never on claim nodes (gm_schema_v2 field list stays closed); ex_single_call cache economics unchanged.
close_reason: Run records landed TDD: red (property tests for exactly-one-row-per-call, machine-readable reasons on failure outcomes, no reason field on claim nodes), green (Reason snake_case codes incl. evidence_not_contained ready for 0hs.7; Finish::Parked/GateRejected carry reason structurally — illegal states unrepresentable; ExtractionRun 6-field row, deny_unknown_fields; append-only ExtractionRunStore parallel to the (episode id, extractor version) cache, economics unchanged). 19 tests + clippy -D warnings green; spk/ah/dont gates green.

Green: extend gate/post-pass with containment verification and reason recording. Depends on schema v2 evidence field and run-record reason plumbing.

description: Applies openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/tasks.md 2.1-2.3, TDD. Red: property test that claim nodes expose exactly the v2 field set (seven v1 fields + evidence, types preserved, no extras). Green: add evidence to claim-node schema/types; migration backfills evidence=unknown on existing nodes and reports the count loudly (never silent; no node dropped or rewritten). Migration backfill does NOT schedule re-extraction; unknown spans are flagged, actionable later. Blocked by spec tickets.

Meter: cargo test — claim-node v2 field-set test red, then green; migration backfill count reported loudly. ANTI-GOAL: no confidence field, no vector blob — gm_schema_v2 adds evidence ONLY. Regression: cargo test + clippy -D warnings stay green.
close_reason: Claim-node schema v2 landed TDD: red 3cf426d (property tests for exactly-8-field set + hedge preservation), green 714ed49 (ClaimNode with evidence Span/Unknown tagged enum, deny_unknown_fields; migrate_v1_to_v2 with loud MigrationReport, reextraction_scheduled=0; ClaimStore::insert rejects HedgeMarkerDropped). 15 tests + clippy -D warnings green; ah check, spk lint, dont gates green. bajan-cdi folded in: store.rs created fresh with typed API — no Result<(),_> stub trap introduced.

title: Implement human-only adopt path with per-claim audit
description: Applies openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/tasks.md 3.1-3.2, TDD. Red: no automated stage (pipeline stage, re-ingest, merge) can move proposed->active. Green: actor check on adopt path (CLI bajan adopt); batch accept loops with per-claim audit records (actor=local operator identity from suite envelope/config, timestamp); preserves per-claim reversibility.
notes: Layout from bajan-2xv is in place. Spec tickets .1/.2 closed with ah check green — that precondition is satisfied. Red: adopt tests unresolved; Green: ClaimStore::adopt/adopt_batch sole Active-setting API (refusal structural), AuditRecord per claim, StoreError::AdoptRefused, CLI bajan adopt <claims>... --actor with envelope (honest ok:false on empty session store; ok:true verified on seeded store). RO5U review converged stage 4 GOOD 0 critical; EDGE-001 (>=1 key) + CLAR-001 fixed; CORR-003 deferred to bajan-ts6. 26 tests + clippy -D warnings green.

title: Implement supersession semantics on version-bump re-extraction
description: Applies openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/tasks.md 4.1-4.2, TDD. Red: property test — version-bump re-extract supersedes only that episode's staged (proposed) claims from prior versions; active and rejected claims unchanged; lineage and evidence survive tombstoning (rejected + superseded-by-reextraction, never deleted); same-version re-ingest reuses cache, resurrects nothing. Green: implement supersession on re-extract path; route active-claim conflicts through existing invalidation-proposal mechanism (ex_mutation_proposal). Depends on run-record reasons for the tombstone reason.
notes: Layout from bajan-2xv is in place. Dependencies on .3 (evidence field) and .6 (reason plumbing) are encoded. Meter: cargo test — supersession property red, then green. ANTI-GOAL: tombstone, never delete; no parallel version-keyed claim sets (design.md D1 rejected alternative).

title: Spec: add gm_human_adopt + gm_schema_v2 to specs/graph-model.md
description: Applies openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/tasks.md 1.1-1.2 (+1.6 gates). Add constraint gm_human_adopt: only an explicit human accept action (CLI bajan adopt, batch permitted, per-claim audited with actor+timestamp) moves proposed->active; update the adopt transition guard. Pre-apply check via spk explain whether specodelic guards accept conjunction citations; fallback is gm_human_adopt as sole guard (gm_reified already forbids unlinked claims). Add deriving property per constraint so spk lint (coverage, no_orphan_property) passes. traces_to cites corpus invariants only (linter.total_refs); fpa provenance in prose. title: Spec: add supersession, run records, evidence containment to specs/extraction-claims.md
description: Applies openspec/changes/update-extraction-provenance/tasks.md 1.3-1.5 (+1.6 gates). Add constraints: ex_supersession (version-bump re-extract supersedes only that episode's staged/proposed claims from prior versions; active+rejected preserved; tombstone reason superseded-by-reextraction; lineage+evidence survive; conflicts with active route through ex_mutation_proposal); ex_run_record (run row per extraction call: episode id, extractor version, model id if any, timestamps, finish status; machine-readable reasons for parked episodes and gate rejections; reasons never on claim nodes; parallel to ex_single_call cache economics, not changing them); ex_evidence_containment (whitespace-collapsed containment at the typed gate; evidence-not-contained reason, never repaired; unknown spans allowed, flagged via extended ex_reflection pass). title: Create openspec change proposal for bajan KG pipeline
description:
Design the core pipeline per knowledge-graphs-report.md best practices: schema-first extraction config, deterministic ingestion (episodes), LLM extraction behind a trait (only for prose-only facts), entity resolution via embeddings, provenance as graph structure (edge metadata -> episode nodes, merge keeps all parents, invalid_at on mutation), SQLite triple store (no graph DB), deletion as graph walk. Proposal in openspec/changes/.

ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA (Must gate):
- openspec/changes/<id>/proposal.md, design.md, and tasks.md exist and cover all seven practices above, each traceable to a report section
- openspec validate --strict passes (Meter: openspec validate <id> --strict)
- proposal explicitly states what is NOT built in MVP (anti-goal): no graph DB, no LLM in the ingestion path for structure that already exists (report §3/§4)

TYPE: HITL — proposal requires human approval before implementation issues are filed.

title: cli: replace Result<(),_> stub signature before implementing modules (unreachable! trap)
description:
Rule-of-5 review CORR-002 (2026-09-29): cli.rs:96 stub_envelope treats Ok(()) from stub modules as unreachable!() — a production panic waiting for the first implementation that returns Ok.

Fix: when each of bajan-0hs.3/.5/.6/.7 un-todos its module, change the signature to return the real data type (the eventual shape) instead of Result<(),_>, and delete the unreachable arm — never grow into the trap. Sequence with each implementation ticket; no standalone work needed unless implementation order changes.

Anti-goal note: do not 'fix' by making Ok a success envelope — the stub semantics change belongs to the implementation tickets.

title: specs: parked-episode extraction retry accounting
description:
From the edge-case pass [BIZ-005]: ex_single_call defines cache reuse only for successfully extracted episodes. Behavior when re-ingesting an episode parked in extraction's rejected state (repeated LLM failure) is unspecified: does re-ingest start a fresh retry budget or stay parked?

Define and encode in extraction.claims (with ingestion.contract alignment for rejection reason records):
- re-ingest of a parked episode: fresh retry budget vs stay-parked decision
- run-record accounting for the chosen semantics (parallel to update-extraction-provenance's reason records)
- property covering park -> re-ingest -> retry/stop paths

Depends on the resubmission-policy decisions ticket (shared ingestion-contract.md edits, serialized).

title: specs: re-ingest after episode deletion
description:
From the edge-case pass [BIZ-003]: graph.model.gm_lineage_survives permits deleting an episode when no claim supports it, but the graph after (ingest -> delete -> re-ingest) vs plain ingest is unspecified.

Define and encode in ingestion.contract (+ gm_lineage_survives interplay in graph-model.md):
- whether a deleted episode's stable id is re-ingestable and recreation semantics
- no-resurrection rule alignment with the update-extraction-provenance scenario (discarded claims stay rejected; re-entry to staged requires explicit re-stage)
- property covering ingest -> delete -> re-ingest graph identity

Depends on the resubmission-policy decisions ticket (same file, serialized edits).
